lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mal kooRee naam utaareean jap naam hoaa sachiaar ||
lines.translation: The Naam washes off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Naam, one becomes truthful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਹਿ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jis de ehi chalat hahi so jeevau devanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, wondrous are the plays of the Lord, the Giver of life. ||2||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad daataa naahi kis aakh sunaaeeai ||
lines.translation: You are the Great Giver; no other is as great as You. Unto whom should I speak and talk?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee paai jithahu haumai jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I find You; You eradicate egotism from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras kas saadaa baaharaa sachee vadiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: You are beyond sweet and salty flavors; True is Your glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no bakhase tis dei aap lae milaaeeai ||
lines.translation: You bless those whom You forgive, and unite them with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: ghat a(n)tar a(n)mrit rakhion guramukh kisai piaaee ||9||
lines.translation: You have placed the Ambrosial Nectar deep within the heart; the Gurmukh drinks it in. ||9||
Salok, Third Mehl:
The stories of one's ancestors make the children good children.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: j satigur bhaavai s ma(n)n lain seee karam karen ||
lines.translation: They accept what is pleasing to the Will of the True Guru, and act accordingly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaai puchhahu simrit saasat biaas suk naarad bachan sabh srisat karen ||
lines.translation: Go and consult the Simritees, the Shaastras, the writings of Vyaas, Suk Dayv, Naarad, and all those who preach to the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai laae sach lage sadaa sach samaalen ||
lines.translation: Those, whom the True Lord attaches, are attached to the Truth; they contemplate the True Name forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਏ ਜਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan bhae j sagale kul taaren ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved; they redeem all their ancestors. ||1||
Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa sikh bhee a(n)dhe karam karen ||
lines.translation: The disciples whose teacher is blind, act blindly as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi bhaanai chalan aapanai nit jhootho jhooth bolen ||
lines.translation: They walk according to their own wills, and continually speak falsehood and lies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kusat kamaavade par ni(n)daa sadaa karen ||
lines.translation: They practice falsehood and deception, and endlessly slander others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi aap dube par ni(n)dakaa sagale kul doben ||
lines.translation: Slandering others, they drown themselves, and drown all their generations as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jit oi laae tit lage ui bapuRe kiaa karen ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whatever the Lord links them to, to that they are linked; what can the poor creatures do? ||2||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nadaree a(n)dar rakhadaa jetee sisat sabh keetee ||
lines.translation: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik kooR kusat laaian manamukh vigootee ||
lines.translation: He has linked some to falsehood and deception; these self-willed manmukhs are plundered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa dhiaaeeai a(n)dar har preetee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord forever; their inner beings are filled with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਵਾਤਿ ਸਿਪੀਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau potai pu(n)n hai tinh vaat sipeetee ||
lines.translation: Those who have the treasure of virtue, chant the Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sach siphat sanaaee ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, and the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||10||
Salok, First Mehl:
Men of charity gather wealth by committing sins, and then give it away in donations to charity.
Their spiritual teachers go to their homes to instruct them.
The woman loves the man only for his wealth;
they come and go as they please.
No one obeys the Shaastras or the Vedas.
Everyone worships himself.
Becoming judges, they sit and administer justice.
They chant on their malas, and call upon God.
They accept bribes, and block justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko puchhai taa paR sunaae ||
lines.translation: If someone asks them, they read quotations from their books.
The Muslim scriptures are in their ears and in their hearts.
They plunder the people, and engage in gossip and flattery.
They anoint their kitchens to try to become pure.
Behold, such is the Hindu.
The Yogi, with matted hair and ashes on his body, has become a householder.
The children weep in front of him and behind him.
He does not attain Yoga - he has lost his way.
Why does he apply ashes to his forehead?
O Nanak, this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
everyone says that he himself knows. ||1||
First Mehl:
The Hindu comes to the house of a Hindu.
He puts the sacred thread around his neck and reads the scriptures.
He puts on the thread, but does evil deeds.
His cleansings and washings will not be approved.
The Muslim glorifies his own faith.
